answerDays.label: Answer a customer's privacy request within (days)
answerDays.help: The days the shop has to answer a customer who asks for a copy of their data or to have it erased. The Data & privacy page counts the days left. Nothing closes a request by itself.

matching.label: ERP accounts for shop money
matching.help: Which ERP account courier cash and bKash payments land in, and which account the shop pays the ERP from. The ERP warehouse is chosen on the same card.
